description: Nikon has launched the Z5IIC full-frame mirrorless camera in India. The new model supports video recording in 4K UHD at up to 60 fps and Full HD at up to 120 fps. The camera can also be used for live streaming by connecting it to a PC via a USB cable. It has a REC lamp that clearly shows when recording is in progress. It supports Nikon’s proprietary N-Log. It features a 3.2-inch touchscreen display.
title: Nikon Z5IIC Full-Frame Mirrorless Camera Launched in India With 4K Video Recording: Price, Specifications

description: Spotify has brought its music, podcast and audiobook services to Meta’s Muse personal AI agent through a new integration. After connecting their accounts, users can search for content, control playback, manage their Library and create playlists using conversational commands. Muse can also generate Personal Podcasts from users’ notes and briefings. The integration supports scheduled playback based on activities and calendar events, while Spotify has outlined a road-trip feature that can create a destination-based playlist and arrange its automatic playback.
title: Spotify Integrates With Meta Muse to Control Music, Podcasts and Audiobooks

description: Sennheiser has launched the Momentum 5 Wireless and Momentum True Wireless 5 headphones in India. The Sennheiser Momentum 5 Wireless is priced at Rs. 39,990 in India, while the Momentum True Wireless 5 costs Rs. 29,990. Gadgets360 sat down with Saahil Kumar, Country Head, Sennheiser (Consumer), India, to know more about the company's plan for India.
title: Sennheiser India Head on Momentum 5, Replaceable Batteries, and Why Sound Still Comes First

description: Cult Kinetic Massage Gun has been launched in India as the fitness brand's latest recovery device. It features a 3,800 RPM BLDC motor. It has four silicone massage heads and an ergonomic angled handle. The new device is priced at Rs. 4,999. It is claimed to deliver up to five hours of battery life on a single charge. The Cult  Kinetic Massage Gun is engineered for athletes, fitness enthusiasts and high-performance individuals.
title: Cult Kinetic Massage Gun Launched in India With 3,800 RPM BLDC Motor

description: European financial regulators have warned that advances in quantum computing could eventually undermine cryptographic systems protecting transactions, databases and blockchains. The authorities said the risks could emerge before commercially viable quantum applications become available, highlighting the need for financial firms and infrastructure providers to prepare for post-quantum security measures.
title: Quantum Computing Could Threaten Blockchain Security, EU Watchdogs Warn

description: Motorola is expanding its Qira AI assistant to more smartphones across the Signature, Razr and Edge series with the rollout of Android 17. Qira can be activated by saying "Hey Qira," pressing a dedicated AI key, or using on-screen shortcuts. The AI assistant offers a unified AI experience across compatible phones, tablets and PCs. It has a Catch me up feature that summarises notifications, messages, and updates. It has Creator Zone and Style Sync tools that generate custom wallpapers, stickers, and avatars.
title: Motorola Qira AI Assistant Set to Reach More Devices With Android 17 Update

description: Tokenised real-world asset deposits rose from $2.3 billion to $7.4 billion between Q2 2025 and Q2 2026, even as overall DeFi deposits declined by about 15 percent, according to CoinShares and Token Terminal. Tokenised Treasuries, multi-strategy products and private-credit assets were among the main sources of RWA collateral. RWA spot trading also increased during the period, led by tokenised gold and funds.
title: RWA Deposits Surge to $7.4 Billion as CoinShares Reports Threefold Growth

description: Samsung has introduced fingerprint-based authentication for UPI payments through Samsung Wallet in India. Galaxy users can authorise eligible transactions worth up to Rs. 10,000 without entering their UPI PIN. The company says the on-device authentication can help users avoid exposing their PIN while making payments in public and may reduce failures caused by incorrect PIN entries. Samsung Wallet also supports contactless card payments, bill payments and digital storage, while its Trips feature brings travel bookings and tickets together in a single timeline.
title: Samsung Wallet Adds Fingerprint Authentication for UPI Payments Up to Rs 10,000 in India

description: Microsoft has expanded its Surface lineup with two new Windows PCs and a wireless mouse. The Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch use Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X2 Plus platform, with up to 24GB RAM and 512GB storage. The Pro supports a detachable keyboard and Slim Pen, while the Laptop includes a full-size backlit keyboard and precision touchpad. Both offer Wi-Fi 7, 500-nit touchscreens and Windows 11 Home. Microsoft claims up to 22.5 hours of video playback on Surface Laptop 13-inch.
title: Microsoft Surface Pro 12-inch, Surface Laptop 13-inch Launched With Snapdragon X2 Plus CPU: Price, Specifications

description: Embark Studios have detailed the new content coming with Arc Raiders' next major update. The Frozen Trail free update will add a new map, new weapons and gadgets, a customisable outpost, a Rewards Pass system, and more. The free update launches October 8.
title: Arc Raiders' Next Major Update, Frozen Trail, Detailed Ahead of October Release

description: Meta Platforms kicked off Meta Connect, its annual multi-day conference, on Wednesday. The company expanded its AI wearables lineup by introducing Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 and Meta VR Glasses. While there is no word on the India availability of the VR glasses, Meta is bringing its third-generation Ray-Ban Meta Glasses to India. The new generation expands the lineup with additional frame styles, including the Aviator and Zena, alongside the familiar Wayfarer. The Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Glasses bring improvements across battery life, audio capture, camera capabilities, and design.
title: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 Hits India at Rs. 44,300: Is the Upgrade Over the Gen 2 Actually Worth It?

description: Truecaller users can now choose to display their professional details on the platform thanks to its new partnership with LinkedIn. The integration lets Truecaller users log in to LinkedIn and connect their professional profiles, enabling them to display their job title, photo, and other details on the caller ID platform.
title: Truecaller Users Can Now Display LinkedIn-Verified Professional Details on Caller ID: What You Need to Know

description: Cross-border stablecoin transaction volumes rose 77.5 percent to $220.3 billion (roughly Rs. 21,13,779 crore) in the 12 months through June 2026, even as total crypto market capitalisation fell 37 percent to $2.1 trillion (roughly Rs. 2,01,49,500 crore). Chainalysis attributed the growth to stablecoins being used for payments, supplier transactions, remittances, and moving savings across currencies.
title: Stablecoin Cross-Border Transactions Rise 78 Percent Despite Crypto Bear Market

description: OpenAI and Anthropic launched new cost-efficient artificial intelligence models. The move comes as demand for lower-cost AI services continues to grow. OpenAI has expanded its GPT-6 lineup with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, while Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5 as part of its Claude 5.5 model family. The AI companies are facing increasing competition from lower-cost open-weight models.
title: OpenAI, Anthropic Announce Cheaper AI Models as Competition From Open-Weight Models Grows

description: Dyson launched the V16 Piston Animal vacuum cleaner in India on Thursday. The latest addition to the company’s cleaning lineup offers stronger suction, hair detangling and easier dust disposal. It is powered by a 900W Hyperdymium motor and delivers up to 315AW of suction. Dyson has equipped the V16 Piston Animal with a new All Floor Cones Sense cleaner head, which is claimed to automatically adapt to different floor types. The vacuum cleaner features a dust-compressing bin, whole-machine HEPA filtration, and up to 70 minutes of runtime.
title: Dyson V16 Piston Animal Vacuum Cleaner Launched in India With Anti-Tangle Cleaner Head: Price, Specifications

description: Sennheiser has introduced two new premium wireless audio products in India, with the Momentum 5 Wireless priced at Rs. 39,990 and the Momentum True Wireless 5 priced at Rs. 29,990. The over-ear headphones offer 42mm drivers, adaptive ANC and up to 57 hours of claimed playback. The true wireless earbuds feature 7mm drivers, adaptive ANC, Dolby Atmos and up to 40 hours of claimed total battery life. Both models support replaceable batteries and are available for pre-order ahead of sales from October 1.
title: Sennheiser Momentum 5 Wireless, Momentum True Wireless 5 Launched in India With Replaceable Batteries: Price, Specifications

description: Meta unveiled several new products and updates at Connect 2026, expanding its AI glasses and virtual reality ecosystem. Ray-Ban Meta Audio introduces open-ear audio, while the third-generation Ray-Ban Meta brings a slimmer design and upgraded camera. Meta also detailed new frame options and AI features, including hearing enhancement and Muse integration. Its 100-gram Meta VR Glasses are set to launch in 2027 with 5K visuals, 3D entertainment and immersive sports support. The event also included a major Beat Saber update and new VR games.
title: Everything Announced at Meta Connect 2026: Ray-Ban Meta Audio, Meta VR Glasses, Muse and More

description: The iPhone 17 Pro is available at a lower effective price at Reliance Digital through a combination of an in-store discount, exchange value, exchange bonus and bank cashback. The 256GB model, which is originally priced at Rs. 1,34,900, can be brought down to an effective price of Rs. 56,990 after applying all the listed benefits. The iPhone 17 Pro Max's effective price comes down to Rs. 71,990.
title: iPhone 17 Pro Reliance Digital Offer: How to Get It Under Rs. 60,000

description: Google on Wednesday announced the expansion of the apps within Gemini’s Connect Apps ecosystem. The Mountain View-based tech giant has introduced a new set of third-party services that can be directly accessed within the AI chatbot. Google says its latest additions span categories such as Productivity, creativity, and lifestyle. They allow users to manage projects, create visual assets, build websites, search for homes, plan workouts, and find event tickets without constantly switching between apps.
title: Gemini Gets New Connected Apps for Adobe, Airtable, Peloton, SeatGeek and More

description: Sources now say Apple will keep the unique curved-glass, near-bezeless design for its 20th-anniversary iPhone. A new source says Apple has reportedly favoured a unique design over advanced display technologies like COE and LTPO+. Indeed, the memory crisis is to blame, but Apple is reportedly seeking better display technologies.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone Said to Favour Unique Display Over Advanced Technology

description: Xbox announced that Obsidian Entertainment will move to operate under Bethesda as part of wider studio restructuring. Now, Bethesda has said that Obsidian's creative identity will not change under its remit. Obsidian is working on a new Fallout project in collaboration with Bethesda.
title: Bethesda Says Obsidian's Creative Identity Will Not Change After Xbox Restructuring

description: Qualcomm launched the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipsets earlier this week. Xiaomi launched the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in China with the new flagship chipsets. The upcoming OnePlus 16, iQOO 16, Motorola, HONOR and RedMagic phones are also confirmed to use the new mobile platforms.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Series: Here Are All the Phones Featuring the New Chipsets

description: After confirming its design, colourways and storage variants, OnePlus has now revealed the cameras of its upcoming flagship. The OnePlus 16 is now confirmed to feature a high-resolution 200-megapixel primary camera, paired with two other 50-megapixel rear-facing cameras. The company also revealed Oppo’s LUMO imaging engine, which will power the OnePlus 16 flagship.
title: OnePlus 16 Camera Specifications Revealed; Will Feature a 200-Megapixel Primary Camera and More

description: The Amazfit T-Rex Dual Solar comes with a 660mAh battery and a dual-sided solar charging system designed to extend runtime away from a charger. Its rear solar panel can help recover power when the watch is removed, while the front panel collects energy during use. The smartwatch also brings sapphire glass, a titanium bezel, dual-band GPS and colour maps for outdoor navigation. It supports Bluetooth calls, more than 180 workout modes, health tracking and diving up to 50m.
title: Amazfit T-Rex Dual Solar Launched With Dual-Sided Solar Charging, Up to 25 Days of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Bitcoin has pulled back towards $84,400 after reaching an eight-month high, with rising US Treasury yields and expectations of further rate hikes weighing on risk appetite. Institutional demand remains supportive as spot Bitcoin ETFs continue to attract inflows, but upcoming inflation and employment data, along with a major options expiry, could add volatility.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $85,000 as Rising Treasury Yields Pressure Crypto Market

description: Mivi One 5G has been launched as the company's first smartphone in India. It features a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset and a 6,000mAh battery. It comes in five colour options and has a  50-megapixel primary rear camera. It has an IP64 rating for dust and water protection. The Mivi One 5G  features a 6.74-inch HD+ display with a 90Hz refresh rate and an 8-megapixel selfie camera.
title: Mivi One 5G Launched in India With Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Google Fitbit Air has appeared on Flipkart ahead of its expected October arrival in India. The listing shows a price of Rs. 13,999 and confirms a 12g weight and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity. The screenless fitness tracker features optical heart rate, SpO2 and skin temperature sensors, along with a three-axis accelerometer and gyroscope. It tracks sleep, cardio load, readiness and more than 40 exercise modes. Google claims up to seven days of battery life, while five minutes of charging can provide a day's usage.
title: Google Fitbit Air Spotted on Flipkart Ahead of India Launch: Expected Price, Features

description: Apple Pay has remained one of the notable omissions from India’s digital payments ecosystem. In recent months, however, the rumour mill has suggested that its launch could be on the horizon. Apple now appears to be building out its payments operations in the country. A new job listing published by the Cupertino-based tech giant specifically mentions Apple Pay and its India operations. The listing points to work involving banks, payment networks, and other partners.
title: Apple Pay India Launch Appears Closer as New Job Listing for Payments Role Surfaces

description: YouTube on Wednesday expanded its creator-focused toolkit with a range of new features. At the Made on YouTube event, the company announced a series of updates to support the entire video-making process, from finding ideas and editing footage to managing comments and protecting creators’ identities. There are new AI-powered capabilities across YouTube Studio, Shorts, and the YouTube Create app. The platform is also adding shopping-focused functionality to its Ask YouTube conversational search feature, while Shorts is getting a new series format.
title: YouTube Announces New AI Tools for Creators, Ask YouTube Shopping Features and Shorts Series

description: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 platform at Snapdragon Summit 2026 on Thursday. The new chip is designed to provide expanded on-device intelligence for the next generation of audio wearables. Qualcomm says its new platform offers Snapdragon Sound technologies, combined with on-device AI, micro-power Wi-Fi 6E, and cloud-connected intelligence. It is designed to support a wider range of devices, including earbuds, headphones, open-ear audio products, audio glasses, and camera-enabled earbuds.
title: Qualcomm Launches Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 for AI-Powered Audio Wearables at Snapdragon Summit 2026
